top_choice_rationale: P001 most strongly combines a fundamental, mature physiological discovery with broad, sustained therapeutic consequences in diabetes and obesity. The Holst-Mojsov-Drucker allocation is defensible when the citation remains confined to GLP-1 physiology that enabled therapies, rather than later drug optimization and implementation.
